limits: Strict open axis-aligned main card interiors; enclosing containers excluded and intentional repeat background stack backplates separate.
Bounds here cover nominal rectangles and serialized route points only; not text glyphs, font resolution, stroke/marker extents or pixels.
Endpoint agreement/zero front-card penetration/bounded objects do not imply publication-quality routing. All overlaps, point contacts and strict crossings remain retained by per-case reports.
No raster synchronization, capture timing/cause, actual-save acquisition/live-store fidelity, runtime/performance or human certification.
Physical font units are nominal; fitted scenes can appear same shape at85/180mm, which does not prove physical-page readability.
Wrong unrecaptured L1 paper85 is excluded and not audited/counted; L3 primer-only or future captures do not count in this12case aggregate.
